target.definition: Number of heavy-duty trucks sold in China in calendar year 2024

provenance.rationale: Approximate 2024 nominal GDP based on recent growth trends and exchange rates.

inputs.name: truck_sales_per_gdp
inputs.description: Heavy-duty truck sales per unit of GDP in China

provenance.rationale: Derived from historical ratio: ~900k trucks sold in 2023 with GDP ~17.8T USD, giving ~5e-8; adjusted for 2024.

inputs.name: truck_sales_2023
inputs.description: Heavy-duty truck sales in China in 2023

provenance.quote: China's heavy truck sales reached 910,000 units in 2023.

inputs.name: growth_factor
inputs.description: Year-over-year growth factor for heavy-duty truck sales from 2023 to 2024

provenance.rationale: Expected modest growth due to economic recovery and infrastructure spending, but with uncertainty.

inputs.name: truck_sales_per_capita
inputs.description: Heavy-duty truck sales per capita in China

provenance.rationale: Based on ~900k trucks and 1.4B population, giving ~0.00064; adjusted for 2024.
Recent population estimates from UN and Chinese statistics.

paths.description: Estimate truck sales as a share of GDP.
Project 2024 sales from 2023 sales using a growth factor.
